artworks.title: Jan de Vos
artworks.description: The image shows a bust portrait of a man facing slightly to the right. He is depicted with his upper body, including his torso and head. The man has a prominent brow, deep-set eyes, and a pronounced nose. His hair is long, wavy, and reaches past his shoulders. He is wearing a dark garment with a wide, white collar. He holds a rolled-up document in his hand. The background has a textured pattern, and there is an ornate signature at the bottom of the portrait.

artworks.title: Jan de Vos
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a man from the mid-torso up. He is seated, positioned slightly towards the right but gazing directly at the viewer. The man has long, curly hair that flows down past his shoulders and a mustache. His facial features include a broad forehead, pronounced nose, and full lips, with a serious expression on his face. He is wearing a dark garment with a wide, white, pointed collar. In his hand is a rolled piece of paper held in the foreground. The background is a textured, patterned surface. Above his left shoulder, there are initials or a partial name "J. Vondel", and below the image is a block of text written in a neat script.

artworks.title: Woman Crossing a Stream
artworks.description: The image shows a woman standing close to us, slightly turned to the side, looking down, with a hand supporting her draped attire and the other grasping a stick. Next to her, a donkey drinks from a shallow stream, carrying a large wicker basket with barrels inside. A dog is splashing in the water beside them. The horizon is low, meeting a rise of land with trees and shrubs, leading the eye to a distant pathway where a couple of small figures can be seen. The sky above has sketchily rendered clouds. The style involves fine, detailed linework, characteristic of etching, emphasizing textures such as the fur of the donkey and the folds of the fabric. The color palette is monochromatic, relying on various intensities of ink and line density to render shadows and highlights.

artworks.title: Laocoon
artworks.description: The image shows a classical scene from an elevated viewpoint. The horizon is visible in the upper third, depicting distant architectural structures resembling an ancient cityscape. The detailed linework suggests an engraving technique, with textures and shading. The color scheme is monochromatic, using sepia and black. In the foreground, three figures battle serpentine creatures. To the right, a burning altar or brazier is below a colonnade with a statue. Beyond, grand architecture with columned structures and arched ruins can be seen, extending towards the skyline where additional towers and buildings stand. The image blends architectural grandeur with mythological drama.

artworks.title: Hercules and Antaeus
artworks.description: The image shows two muscular figures in a dynamic struggle. The dominant figure is lifting the other high into the air. Both figures are detailed with intricate lines and shading, conveying motion and drama. Their exaggerated muscular forms and dynamic poses suggest a scene from classic mythology or ancient heroism. The background is minimalistic, directing focus to the central action.

artworks.title: The Recording Angel
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated on a rocky surface, with one leg extended outward. They have short, curly hair and a calm facial expression. Large wings extend from their back. The person wears a draped garment covering their lower body, with their upper body exposed. They hold a book or tablet in their left hand, resting on their lap. Clouds are visible above, and the terrain is rocky with some vegetation in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.description: Two figures are depicted mostly in full length, with attention drawn to their upper bodies and facial expressions. The scene involves a woman standing upright, gesturing towards a winged figure positioned on the left who is mid-air atop a cloud. The woman has finely drawn facial features with an intent expression and her hair styled close to her head. Her clothing consists of a long flowing garment and a shawl draped around her shoulders. The winged figure has curly hair flowing around their head, reaching out with one hand and also wearing a draped garment. Between the figures, there is a pedestal featuring a carved figure. Above them, clouds fill the sky with a small bird outlined mid-flight and a face peeking through the clouds. The background shows architectural elements, such as a building with distinct lines.

artworks.title: Martyrdom of Saint Andrew
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an intense and dramatic narrative scene. Several male figures are in the foreground around a table, with one figure lying down and being restrained while another is whipping them. In the background, more figures are watching through large window columns, with structures resembling classical architecture and a distant landscape. The artwork is rendered in a detailed line style, likely from the Baroque period or a similar era known for its emphasis on human emotion and physicality.

artworks.title: The Virgin and Child on a Grassy Bank
artworks.description: This image shows a woman holding a child in her lap outdoors. The woman is seated, turned slightly to the left, with delicate facial features and long hair partially covered by a headscarf. The child is leaning against her, with their face close to hers. The woman is wearing flowing garments and there is no visible jewelry. The background features hills and lightly sketched foliage.

artworks.title: Bacchanale
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 36.4 × 55.3 cm (14 5/16 × 21 3/4 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological scene in a dense forest. The image shows various fantastical creatures and characters engaging in lively activity surrounded by intricate tree foliage. The scene features muscular figures playing instruments and dancing, set against a detailed backdrop of trees. The figures' anatomy and the texture of leaves are emphasized through line work and shading, creating a complex visual narrative.

artworks.title: Mercury Silencing Battus
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a large, gnarled tree dominating the left side. The intricate branches and foliage are depicted through fine etching. Mountains are in the background, blending into the cloudy sky. The brushwork captures textures of the tree bark, leaves, and landscape. The monochromatic color palette emphasizes details and contours. Close to the viewer, there are horses under the tree. Two figures are leading a donkey. A river flows in the distance, flanked by trees, leading to the mountains. The scene conveys tranquil rural life in detailed etching.

artworks.title: The Brazen Bull of Phalarus
artworks.description: This is a print showing a group of people gathered around a statue of a bull. The central focus is on the bull, which stands on a platform above a fire with smoke billowing around it. A door appears to open on the side of the bull's body, and two men on the left of the print are holding the legs of another person who has their head and torso inside the compartment of the bull. One person is kneeling on the right of the bull, appearing to feed the fire underneath it. Another person stands behind them, holding a large object that looks like a log. In the top left corner of the print, a man is seated on a throne-like structure elevated above the others, flanked by attendants or guards, observing the event. More onlookers stand on the ground behind the bull. The scene is set against a backdrop featuring classical columns and archways which show the edge of a building in the distance.

artworks.title: Heraclius Sentencing the Tyrant Phocas
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a royal figure overseeing a dramatic scene involving burning books or documents. The monochromatic drawing shows a regal scene where a figure sits on an ornate chair, pointing to a pile of burning books or scrolls with smoke rising. Surrounding the figure are armed guards, and in the background are an assembly of people, a dome-topped building, and other architectural elements. The drawing is detailed, showing texture in clothing, expressive faces, and motion in the flames and smoke.

artworks.title: The Wife of Hasdrubal Throws Herself on the Fire
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring classical architecture and figures amidst swirling smoke and flames. The central figure is holding two smaller figures, all in flowing robes. In the foreground, classical objects like urns and armor are depicted. The background shows architectural elements resembling classical Roman buildings, with columns and domed structures. Additional figures on the right gesture towards the central scene, adding to the narrative tension. The drawing uses intricate detailing and lines to depict movement and drama, capturing a moment of turmoil and rescue.

artworks.title: The Interior of Saint Peter's, Rome
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and watercolor heightened with white over black chalk on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a painting of an architectural interior scene featuring large columns and decorative arches. The composition showcases a grand classical style with tall columns and ornate detailing on the arches and ceiling. One side of the image is dominated by a large column with a decorative band of multicolored geometric shapes. The perspective leads the eye through the arches towards the more distant sections of the space. Delicate shadows and precise lines highlight the craftsmanship and intricate design elements of the classical architecture. This is in style of Giovanni Battista Piranesi.

artworks.title: The Interior of Saint Peter's, Rome
artworks.artist: Italian 17th Century, border attributed to John Talman
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash and watercolor heightened with white over black chalk on laid paper with gold leaf borders
artworks.description: This is a painting of an ornate architectural interior featuring classical architectural elements such as columns, cornices, arches, and niches within walls. The image is framed with intricate golden patterns. In the background, there are murals or frescoes with detailed designs. The perspective leads the viewer’s eye through the columns towards an opening space with light streaming through. This style is reminiscent of Giovanni Battista Piranesi, known for detailed architectural designs and etchings.

artworks.title: Saint Anne Received by the Virgin and Christ
artworks.description: The image shows three figures and several cherubs. Two main figures are in the center, and a third figure is seated above them. The central figures are shown in full length, with one seated on clouds, looking up, and the other standing to the right. The third figure is above the central figures, also seated on clouds, holding a crown. The central figures have delicate facial features and serene expressions, with long hair covered by draped hoods. The standing figure on the right holds a staff. Both central figures wear flowing robes and halos. The background consists of clouds with cherubs surrounding the main figures. There is minimal detail on the horizon, and the artwork has an etched style.

artworks.title: The Martyrdom of Saint Bartholomew
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated on the ground, with his arms tied to a tree behind him. He is nude except for a cloth around his waist. There are other figures around him, one interacting with him and another bent over. The background includes trees, rocky terrain, a cloudy sky, distant hills or mountains, and some architectural elements.

artworks.title: Pope Sixtus V
artworks.description: The image shows a person kneeling with both hands clasped in front of their chest. The person has a beard and wavy hair, wearing religious garments with intricate embroidery and a cross. Latin text is inscribed at the bottom. The background has horizontal lines.

artworks.title: The Annunciation
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 41.1 × 27.8 cm (16 3/16 × 10 15/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of heavenly figures and clouds. The composition features winged figures among billowing clouds in a celestial setting. Below these figures, more angelic figures with large wings engage in gestures of communication near a classical architectural structure. A potted plant with flowers is present on the left side. The artwork uses intricate lines and shading to create texture and depth.

artworks.title: Male Saint Standing with Folded Arms, Facing to the Right
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in orange-brown, medium, and dark brown
artworks.description: The image shows a person in a standing position. They are depicted in profile with their face turned to the left, and their hair appears windswept. The person has a beard, and there is a halo above their head. They are wearing a long, flowing garment with a cloak over their shoulders. Their feet are bare, visible under the clothing. The setting appears outdoors, with rough terrain and sparse vegetation. The background has a simple two-tone color scheme, with no detailed features, emphasizing the figure.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in light and dark olive green
artworks.dimensions:
sheet: 19.7 × 15.3 cm (7 3/4 × 6 in.)
other (text beneath image): 3.2 × 15.2 cm (1 1/4 × 6 in.)
mount (irreg.): 43.7 × 31.9 cm (17 3/16 × 12 9/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a seated figure on a large bird. The image depicts a classically draped figure seated on a stylized bird. The figure holds an open book and gazes into the distance. The bird has sharp features and spread wings. The background contains swirling clouds. The scene is framed with a border, and there is text at the bottom. The lines are bold and the shades are muted.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut in tan and brown
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a winged figure seated on a bird. The image depicts a figure with flowing robes, wings outstretched, holding an open book in one hand. The figure appears to be looking off to the side, with a serene expression. The lower part of the image includes a bird upon which the figure is seated. The bird's head is turned slightly upwards, following the direction in which the figure is gazing. The image is rendered in a warm, monochromatic palette. In the lower section of the image, there is some text, likely Latin.

artworks.title: Saint John the Evangelist
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an angel holding a book. The image depicts an angelic figure with flowing garments standing with a large open book in one hand. The angel's posture suggests movement, with fabric and hair flowing. The drawing is rendered in varying tones of brown and features detailed lines for texture. The angel is surrounded by clouds, indicating it is in the sky. Text on the left-hand page of the book reads "Ivan Spalirin fe. Apost Scott 1782."
